fsm_states_end_device_mac.name: IDLE_SLEEP
fsm_states_end_device_mac.description: Low-power; radio off; waiting for application data.

fsm_states_end_device_mac.name: JOIN
fsm_states_end_device_mac.description: (OTAA) send Join-Request, open join receive windows, await Join-Accept, derive NwkSKey/AppSKey.

fsm_states_end_device_mac.name: TX
fsm_states_end_device_mac.description: Transmit an uplink LoRa frame (preamble, sync word, header, payload, CRC) on a duty-cycle-permitted channel.

fsm_states_end_device_mac.name: RX1
fsm_states_end_device_mac.description: Open RX1 on the uplink channel/DR (offset by RX1DROffset); demodulate any downlink.

fsm_states_end_device_mac.name: RX2_WAIT
fsm_states_end_device_mac.description: If no RX1 downlink, wait until RECEIVE_DELAY2 (default 2 s).

fsm_states_end_device_mac.name: RX2
fsm_states_end_device_mac.description: Open RX2 on the fixed region frequency/DR.

fsm_states_end_device_mac.name: PROCESS
fsm_states_end_device_mac.description: Verify MIC (NwkSKey), check FCnt, decrypt FRMPayload (AppSKey), process MAC commands; return to IDLE_SLEEP.

fsm_hints.trigger: An application uplink (or scheduled report) moves IDLE_SLEEP -> TX. On power-up an OTAA device enters JOIN first.
fsm_hints.rule: Class A: every TX is followed by RX1 then (if needed) RX2; the radio sleeps otherwise. Class C keeps RX open continuously; Class B adds beacon-synchronized ping slots.
fsm_hints.abort: MIC failure or FCnt replay -> discard frame and return to IDLE_SLEEP; failed join -> retry with backoff.

class_behavior.A: Two RX windows after each uplink; lowest power; mandatory.
class_behavior.B: Class A windows plus scheduled ping slots synchronized to a periodic gateway beacon.
class_behavior.C: Receiver open continuously except while transmitting; lowest downlink latency, highest power.

exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-up an OTAA device enters JOIN and must complete the join procedure before sending data; an ABP device already holds DevAddr/NwkSKey/AppSKey, restores its frame counters from non-volatile memory, and may transmit immediately.
adr_control: When the ADR bit is set, the network server observes uplink SNR/link margin and issues LinkADRReq to raise the data rate (lower SF) and lower TX power; the device confirms with LinkADRAns. Mobile devices may disable ADR.
